text:
Dark mode is here, and we think your eyes will like it. 🌙

Dark mode is now live for all users as of May 12. Nearly 40% of our beta testers asked for it, so we built it.

We went beyond inverting the colors. Body text has a 7:1 contrast ratio, which exceeds the WCAG AAA standard, so notes stay easy to read whether you're writing at midnight or drafting in a sunlit café.

What you get:

🌑 Reduced glare for late-night brainstorming sessions
🎨 High-contrast text that keeps every word sharp
⚡ One-tap switching between light and dark

To turn it on, go to Settings and pick your theme. 💡

Thanks to everyone in the beta who gave us feedback.
